description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said he expects Myles Garrett to play on Sunday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Garrett will be listed as questionable. He should be on the favorable side of it.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) expected to play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Walker came in Friday morning and had "tight groin." "We'll see how he feels through this afternoon, with rehab, and through tomorrow," Reid said. Emmett Johnson should be stashed in all leagues.
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Divine Deablo is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Deablo will likely be ruled out heading into Sunday.
items.title: Divine Deablo (forearm) listed doubtful Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Zachariah Branch has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Branch will be sidelined after missing practice all week.
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Woods is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Woods will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
items.title: Josh Woods listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: James Pearce Jr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Pearce was limited in practice throughout the week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.
items.title: James Pearce Jr. (back) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Gervon Dexter Sr. is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Dexter will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.
items.title: Gervon Dexter Sr. (illness) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jon Gaines II has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Gaines was unable to practice all week due to an ankle injury.
items.title: Jon Gaines II (ankle) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Hjalte Froholdt has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
items.impact: Froholdt will be sidelined as he remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Pickens practiced again on Friday.
items.impact: Pickens remained limited in practice on Thursday. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) practices Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Javon Bullard was back at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Bullard will have a chance to play on Sunday against the Vikings with his return to practice.
items.title: Javon Bullard (ankle/knee) back at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness was back at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Van Ness will have a chance to play on Sunday against the Vikings with his return to practice.
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (back) returns to practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Xavier McKinney did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: McKinney will be a late addition to the injury report. He'll need to be monitored when it is released.
items.title: Xavier McKinney misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Israel Abanikanda will serve as the team's RB2 in Week 10 against the 49ers.
items.impact: Abanikanda will be elevated from the practice squad for Dallas. He will backup Javonte Williams.
items.title: Israel Abanikanda to serve as Cowboys RB2 Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Brooks had his practice window opened this week. He is unlikely to be activated for Sunday.
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (groin) listed doubtful Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Xavier Legette is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Legette will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve on Sunday. He'll likely still remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Saints.
items.impact: Phillips was able to log a full practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Bam Knight will play in Week 10 against the Rams after clearing concussion protocol.
items.impact: Knight was able to log a full practice on Thursday. He'll likely return to a committee with Tyler Allgeier in the Cardinals backfield with Carson Beck making his debut.
items.title: Bam Knight clears concussion protocol, will play Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles waived WR Hollywood Brown.
items.impact: Brown will figure to seek another opportunity. He will remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Hollywood Brown waived by Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals and Elijah Higgins have reached an agreement on a three-year extension worth up to $26.8 million.
items.impact: The deal ties Higgins to Arizona through the 2029 season. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Elijah Higgins signs three-year extension with Cardinals

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is not practicing for the Houston Texans Friday according to Aaron Wilson.
items.impact: Harrison Jr. has yet to progress enough to participate in any practice for head coach DeMeco Ryans, putting the wideout's availability in question for Sunday's contest against the Browns.
items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) not practicing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Michael Burton did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Burton will likely be ruled out after not practicing all week.
items.title: Michael Burton (calf) not practicing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ronnie Hickman Jr. is not practicing on Friday.
items.impact: Hickman will likely be ruled out as he remains in concussion protocol.
items.title: Ronnie Hickman Jr. (concussion) not practicing Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Denzel Boston returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Boston did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday. He'll have a chance to be good to go on Sunday.
items.title: Denzel Boston (toe) back at practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Hunter Henry is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Henry was limited in practice all week. He will remain a borderline TE1 for fantasy managers.
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) off injury report Sunday
